newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colonial State drops home rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colonial State drops home rate.

text.p: Australian regional bank Colonial State Bank said on Wednesday it had lowered its variable home loan rate to 7.55 percent from 8.25 percent.
The move follows the Commonwealth Bank of Australia's decision to cut its variable rate to 7.55 percent from 8.25 percent earlier today.

Colonial said the new rate would be available for all new customers from February 13 and to existing customers from March 27. The bank said it also dropped the rate on its ratesaver mortgage product to 6.95 percent from 7.29 percent.
